review: I teach in a Catholic school I no longer believe in and I am very good at it, which is its own small daily humiliation. I write about faith rarely, to about two thousand people, most of them Irish and most of them standing exactly where I am. I have had a draft open about this album for three weeks. "The Door That Locked Behind Me." The reports came out when I was in my twenties, my uncle was a priest, the family closed ranks and I did not. I did not lose God. I lost the Church and I have never once been able to separate the two cleanly, and here is a record that does not ask me to. Five stars, and I may or may not say so publicly.
